posts.en:
dsh-movein is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Move a whole Claude Code setup into DSH. Skills, MCP servers, hooks, subagents and permission rules, with a dry-run moving estimate and a migration diff report; installs as a plugin exposing a movein_from_claude_code tool so the agent can do the move for you.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-9efe167816318f863fa0.html
